purpose: Teach: サンバ/ボビー/パトリック/クリストファー/リンダ/アーク/アナン/サドル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サンバ部の発表会出てたな
lines.en: You were in the samba club performance, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a smirk. Leans forward slightly. Testing him — she knows she caught him. Light and quick delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ボビー・オロゴンのドラマ観てたな、桜
lines.en: You watched that Bobby Orogun drama, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Immediate comeback, smug. Flat delivery — he's been waiting for this. No apology in the tone, just turnabout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英語の先生がパトリックさんだったな
lines.en: So your English teacher was Patrick, huh?
lines.style: Teasing escalation. Slight laugh underneath. Pushing to see where this is going. Fast-paced, knowing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、クリストファー・コロンブスの本読んでたな、桜
lines.en: You read a book on Christopher Columbus, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm now. Calm confidence. Each fact lands like a small chip shot. No heat, just precision.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、リンダ・カーター主演のワンダーウーマン観てたな
lines.en: You watched Wonder Woman with Linda Carter, didn't you?
lines.style: Triumphant edge. Slight lift at the end — she's enjoying this game. Quick delivery, perfectly timed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でアーク・ド・トリオンフ習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about the Arc de Triomphe in history class, right?
lines.style: Steady counter. No rush. He's building a case now. Almost conversational — like he's reciting obvious facts she should already know.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でアナン事務総長習ったろ?
lines.en: You covered Kofi Annan in history, didn't you?
lines.style: Casual follow-through. Quick, almost offhand. The tempo picks up — they're both locked in now.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車のサドル高くしてたな、桜
lines.en: You adjusted your bike saddle up, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final close-range observation. Delivered with a smile in the voice. Intimate detail — he's been watching. Slight trailing warmth.
